semantics.all_instances: Offline wrappers cover every invocation of the listed script methods, including newly created projected spaces, navigation caches and static transit/clearance helpers. Static helpers have no instance id. Instance counts are observed called instances, not all allocated objects.
semantics.business_validation: Driver must compare frozen world, RNG and semantic event output against the plain same-input run.
semantics.denominator: Externally measured full ordinary Simulation.step elapsed, including its pending wait loop.
semantics.inclusive_group_timers: Auxiliary group/result inclusive timers stop just before bookkeeping and differ by a few timer/dispatch instructions from the authoritative inherited nested-call table.
semantics.nested_calls: Inclusive and exclusive selected dynamic calls; exclusive subtracts timed descendants. Never add inclusive rows or add nested rows to root rows.
semantics.observer_handler_us: Measured handler bodies only; wrapper dispatch and timer read overhead are not fully isolatable. Quantify total perturbation against a paired plain same-input window.
semantics.parameter_groups: Bounded identity-agnostic compact parameter groups include root and immediate timed caller. World/space identities are counted separately. Equal keys do not establish equal world facts, permission, reservation, cache lifetime or legal reuse. Inclusive group/result rows overlap; never add them to call or root timing tables.
semantics.residual_us: Full step minus root spans and observed handlers: outer step setup, pending sleeps, call/return gaps and timer precision.
semantics.root_stages: Disjoint spans in the original step_nonblocking phase order; observed handler time removed.
semantics.selected_indices: Only selected ordinary complete steps install the observer. All earlier prefix steps execute; wrappers take their inactive branch and collect no records. Dispatch/metadata lookup overhead remains, so compare this diagnostic run only with its paired untransformed plain control.

semantics.root: Full-window aggregate; summary details contain selected indices plus the actual ten slowest steps. Complete raw source results and NDJSON are archived.
semantics.all: Only declared selected complete steps contribute to nested-function totals; every ordinary prefix step executes.
semantics.nested: Inclusive timings overlap; exclusive subtracts timed descendants. Never add nested tables to root spans or overlapping inclusive rows together.
semantics.counter_absence: Missing counter fields are unobserved, not independently observed zeroes.
semantics.environment_build_branches: diag_environment_script_builds measures the actual GDScript fallback BFS branch; native and fallback counters remain separate under their original names. Native-path production counters are not inferred from the old coverage-build counter.
semantics.parameter_groups: Bounded examples remain complete in raw NDJSON; compact equality is not a world/permission reuse proof.
